subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Which authorized OpenClaw owner will take custody of the production GitHub OAuth application and coordinate the credential rotation?
rationale: The fix requires control of the current GitHub OAuth application and production Convex secrets; source changes cannot establish ownership or safely perform the rotation.

options.title: Transfer existing app
options.body: Transfer the current OAuth application to an official OpenClaw-controlled owner, update its branding, and validate the existing client and callback configuration.

options.title: Create and rotate app
options.body: Create a new official OAuth application, atomically replace both production credentials, and validate web, docs-chat, and CLI sign-in.

options.title: Accept personal ownership
options.body: Keep the current application only with an explicit security decision documenting personal ownership as an accepted production dependency.

recommendation.title: Transfer existing app
recommendation.body: Transfer the current OAuth application to an official OpenClaw-controlled owner, update its branding, and validate the existing client and callback configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: This account was assigned the prior issue covering the same production OAuth ownership change and is the best available coordination owner.
